documents.title: Provider pacing
documents.content: retry_after_gate delays outbound requests using the server cooldown. It accounts for every attempt and makes queued work wait before hitting a rate ceiling.

documents.title: Legacy outbound cooldown
documents.content: legacy_rate_sleep used one-second constant pacing. Old queued tasks resumed together after restart; timestamp and attempts were not persisted.

documents.title: Local secrets
documents.content: macOS stores provider credentials in the login Keychain. A signed helper rotates a secret and reports denied access without writing credentials to SQLite.

documents.title: Sauvegarde hors ligne
documents.content: Une copie chiffrée de la base locale est déposée sur un volume externe. Un exercice de restauration mesure la capacité à récupérer les fichiers après une coupure.

documents.title: Native gates
documents.content: The CI workflow checks SwiftLint and Clippy, runs macOS UI automation and retains coverage reports. A failed assertion uploads an accessibility attachment.

documents.title: Migration atomique
documents.content: Une migration SQLite reconstruit le catalogue FTS5, contrôle les index et préserve la version des réglages. La transaction annule toute écriture en cas d'échec.

documents.title: Incremental collection
documents.content: commit_delta_checkpoint advances the offset only once normalized records and the search index are durable. An interrupted page is replayed from the predecessor cursor.

documents.title: Diagnostic retention
documents.content: purge_expired_signals removes telemetry older than the configured retention period. Age and row caps keep the telemetry database bounded.

documents.title: Inbound authentication
documents.content: The loopback service requires an ephemeral bearer token and rejects browser Origin headers. CLI clients read a user-private endpoint record.

documents.title: Snapshot tests
documents.content: Snapshots compare rendered SwiftUI appearance and check color differences. Font and padding changes are reviewed against reference images.

documents.title: Code formatting
documents.content: Formatters enforce indentation in Rust and Swift before the compiler runs. They do not inspect runtime permissions or local data.

documents.title: Trace correlation
documents.content: An import trace connects the scheduler and index stages. A query trace tracks lexical lookups. Logs carry identifiers and exclude credentials and raw query text.

documents.title: Dependency health
documents.content: A circuit breaker opens when repeated upstream errors cross the failure threshold. Its half-open state accepts a probe before returning to normal.

documents.title: Shared ownership
documents.content: Deleting one collection drops its ownership of shared documents. Copies remain searchable while another scope owns them, with retained status after access loss.

documents.title: Deployment rollback
documents.content: Release rollback changes the application deployment to a prior healthy image. A deploy gate checks HTTP readiness before promoting infrastructure changes.

documents.title: Settings revision
documents.content: An optimistic revision number rejects stale writes to settings. The current language and retention appear on the settings page after restart.

documents.title: Worker pool
documents.content: A bounded queue protects memory when local jobs run faster than threads can finish. Tasks start when a worker becomes free.

documents.title: Current order cancellation
documents.content: cancel_order_v3 accepts cancellation while payment is pending and hands refund approval to a separate ledger workflow.

documents.title: Historical order cancellation
documents.content: historical_cancel_v1 rejected cancellation as soon as payment authorization began. This revision was retired after the order redesign.

documents.title: Local bookmarks
documents.content: The browser keeps a list of saved pages for the current user. The address bar filters bookmark names and keyboard history.

documents.title: Memory sampling
documents.content: Resident process memory is sampled periodically. Allocator telemetry distinguishes live allocations and free pages retained by the runtime.

documents.title: Accessibility labels
documents.content: The VoiceOver screen reader announces controls by their accessibility labels. Localized labels are tested with an accessibility tree snapshot.

documents.title: Release workflow
documents.content: Release automation publishes notarized app images to a download bucket and signs them with a Developer ID certificate.

documents.title: Disk limits
documents.content: A write budget puts a hard cap on SQLite page allocation. When free space is too low, the writer sheds rows and reports dropped entries.
